info.background_text:
Investigator of the Special Investigations Department.
Known as the SID, the department is responsible for investigating and handling various incidents within Terrascion. She values rules, regulations, and principles, and is always dedicated about carrying out orders meticulously. She has a slight tendency toward perfectionism.
